annotation: Cell-cycle and genomic-instability program; increased in VI-positive tumors and associated with proliferative/high-grade tumor regions.
EMT, angiogenesis, and tissue-remodeling program; increased in VI-positive tumors, with spatial enrichment in desmoplastic stroma and CAF-rich invasive regions.
Hypoxic tumor-metabolism and stress-adaptation program; increased in VI-positive tumors and associated with high-grade tumor regions.
Program decreased in VI-positive tumors, including cell-adhesion and immune-response functions; enriched in less-aggressive and normal-appearing regions.
